data.name: Life Link
data.description: While mounted or within 30 feet of each other, neither you nor your mount can be brought below 1 hit point as long as the other has more than 1 hit point.  All hit point damage in excess of that last 1 hit point is instead applied to the mount, if you are at 1 hit point, or to you, if the mount is at 1 hit point.  When both are at 1 hit point, this ability ceases to work.  In addition, you and the mount are always treated as if under the effects of mindlink to the other.
